answer: Each agent must cultivate a walnut of trust: the beacon emits a signal each epoch, and the agent must plant a zenith seed of reputation. The first verification costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent layer doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at layer 14 (20.4 M iterations). A zenith audit verifies each walnut against the epoch signal; any rotten walnut voids the harvest. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full grove cost because each walnut binds to the unique identity key—no shared roots possible.
